notes.title: Patch #6
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The sixth update is here.

1. Added several types of walkers with different sets of long-range weapons and appearance.
2. Added and adjusted some interface elements. (The character experience bar finally appeared)
3. Fixed several bugs, including the one that led to the appearance of enemies with negative HP. (Yeah, that's how much I simplified the game at the starting levels <3)
3. Other small fixes.

Thanks for the bug reports.
Working on the next update. All the best!

notes.title: Patch #5
notes.content:
Patch with various fixes and improvements.

*Fixed some graphical errors and errors with displaying equipment parameter values.
*Improved game balance.
*Many minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix 0_0_0_4
notes.content:
An interim update with some bug fixes and minor improvements before the next patch.

The most important fixes:
1. Fixed one of the errors leading to the incorrect transition of the turn from the player to the AI.
2. Fixed a bug with the ability to take an unlimited number of allied combat walkers into battle.
3. Fixed the incorrect display of some values ​​in the store, equipment screen and on the cards of allied heroes.

And other small fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.3
notes.content:
Happy New Year warriors!

First patch of the year, several important improvements have been made.

1. Added endless game mode after completing the first 5 systems. After completing them, star systems update their level and enemy types to continue the galactic war.

2. Uploaded new Chinese translation.

3. Slightly changed the progression of rewards for battles.

4. Fixed several bugs.

5. Other minor fixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.2
notes.content:
Hey! Uploaded a small patch.

1.) Fixed some issues with game hardlocks under certain circumstances.

2.) Rebalanced and increased rewards for battles.

3.) Changed the visuals of dangerous areas on the battlefield.

4.) Changed the spread of bullets to avoid accidental hits on your heroes.

5.) Other small fixes.

Currently working on a larger patch with other fixes based on your feedback. It will also include adding new content and rebalancing the current one. All the best!
